_comment: Claim rules for tools/check_claims.py - the machine-checkable half of the
project honesty rules.
THE ENGINE IN ONE SENTENCE: a banned or superseded number may appear in this
repository only inside a passage that disowns it. That is deliberately the
same policy a careful writer already follows, so the checker agrees with the
prose instead of fighting it - docs/site_calibration.md section 4 mentions the
banned 90.0% figure many times and passes clean, because every mention is a
prohibition.
Each rule matches against a BLOCK (a blank-line-separated paragraph or comment
run, whitespace-normalised), not a line, so claims that wrap across lines are
still caught. A rule fires when 'pattern' matches, 'context' also matches if
one is given, and NO 'allowed_when' marker is present in the same block.
Adding a rule is how you retire a number. When a measurement is superseded,
add the old figure here in the same commit that publishes the new one - then
the old figure cannot come back without the checker saying so.

forbidden.reason: Per-site calibration does NOT reach 90% out of sample. The 90.0%/57.9% pair is a post-hoc demonstration on Messidor-2 itself, on random disjoint halves of a benchmark that is now spent and cannot be re-read to check it.
forbidden.instead: Quote the independently-supported IDRiD result: sensitivity 75.0% -> 82.8%, specificity 97.4% -> 76.9% (fit on IDRiD TRAIN n=413, evaluated on held-back TEST n=103). Say that it narrows the transfer gap and does not close it. See docs/site_calibration.md section 4.

forbidden.reason: The 31.2% -> 90.0% transition is the post-hoc Messidor-2 demonstration, not a measured deployment result.
forbidden.instead: State it only while disowning it, or quote the IDRiD replication instead. See docs/site_calibration.md section 4.

forbidden.reason: No clinician has ever been timed using this system. 30 s is Module 4's DESIGN TARGET; the only MEASURED figure is a ~38 s floor on READING the report's critical path, which is already above it.
forbidden.instead: 'Designed for sub-30-second review; not yet timed with a clinician. The measured reading floor alone is ~38 s.' See docs/phase5_results.md section 6.

forbidden.reason: Grad-CAM lesion enrichment is 1.51x versus expert masks - above chance, but not strong corroboration. No ophthalmologist has rated a single heatmap; the reviewer has not been recruited.
forbidden.instead: 'Grad-CAM enrichment 1.51x against expert masks: above chance, NOT validated explainability. No ophthalmologist has rated it.' Protocol is ready in docs/gradcam_review_protocol.md.

forbidden.reason: Research Paper.pdf is a team-supplied IJCSE paper reporting 94.3% accuracy with no sensitivity, no specificity and no external validation. It is background reading, never a benchmark.
forbidden.instead: Use the sourced targets in docs/literature_benchmarks.md (Gulshan, IDx-DR, the IDRiD AUPR ceilings). Reasons in section 5 of that file.

forbidden.reason: This was tested and it is false. The quality gate does not improve grading accuracy - it measured -9.2pp specificity. Its value is clinical, not metric.
forbidden.instead: 'The quality gate does not improve accuracy. Its value is that an ungradable image gets a retake instead of a confident grade.'

forbidden.reason: APTOS has no DME labels, so 90.3% is the DR-only endpoint. IDx-DR and Gulshan report mtmDR, which includes referable DME. The comparison is not like-for-like.
forbidden.instead: Compare on Messidor-2 where the endpoint matches, and label every APTOS number as the DR-only endpoint. See docs/clinical_definitions.md.

forbidden.reason: Blocker B11. These three references could not be located, and a fourth attribution in the same block was provably wrong (initialRejectRate 0.12 credited to phase1_quality_baseline.md, which explicitly says it establishes no reject rate). A judge who checks one citation and finds it wrong discounts the whole deck.
forbidden.instead: Cite config/telemedicine_parameters.json, where each value is tagged SOURCED / DERIVED / ASSUMED against a checked reference. The likely real papers are John et al., Telemed J E Health 2012 (Sankara Nethralaya) and Prathiba & Rema, Int J Family Med 2011 - read the full texts before citing either.

superseded.reason: MA precision 0.046 is the PRE-REBUILD figure. It was bought by a stage-2 classifier discarding candidates on a train/serve geometry mismatch.
superseded.instead: 0.028 (IDRiD segmentation TEST split, n=27, micro-averaged, re-measured 2026-09-13).

superseded.reason: MA recall 0.077 is the PRE-REBUILD figure.
Haemorrhage precision 0.130 is the PRE-REBUILD figure.
Haemorrhage recall 0.054 is the PRE-REBUILD figure.

MA precision 0.054 came from the two-stage evaluation of a pipeline that was never actually wired into production - EXTRACTLESIONFEATURES called DETECTDARKLESIONS with no classifier at all. It measured something that never shipped.
superseded.instead: 0.028, which is what the shipping stage-1-alone configuration actually scores.

superseded.reason: Haemorrhage precision 0.088 came from the two-stage evaluation of a pipeline that never shipped.

_comment: Hard rule 3: every reported metric carries its evaluation protocol. A bare
sensitivity or specificity in a results table is incomplete - published DRIVE
numbers are famously incomparable for exactly this reason.
This is a WARNING by default because prose legitimately spreads the protocol
across a sentence or a table header. Run with --strict to make it fatal.

scan._exclude_note: These three files quote banned claims on purpose: the rulebook defines them, the checker documents them, and the test asserts they are still caught. Scanning them would make the checker fail on its own evidence.
